inNature.summary: Games across the park, points at every stop.
inNature.title: Appro {(In nature)}
text: Take your Appro outdoors. Fresh air, open green space and games spread across the park: tug-of-war by the trees, Mölkky on the grass, a quiz in the shade.
Put a host at every checkpoint and let teams make their way from stop to stop. They check in with a QR code, play for points and follow the scores on the live feed.

intro: An Appro in the park: a day outside with your people, moving from game to game. It works for a class, a student association or a group of friends, and it's easy to set up with Bonfiire.

steps.title: Plan your stops
steps.text: Pick a park, then add a checkpoint in the app for every game on the route.

steps.title: Put a host at each one
steps.text: Invite a checkpoint host for every stop. They run the game and welcome each team.

steps.title: Check in with a QR code
steps.text: Teams show their ticket's QR code at every stop, and the host scans it in a second.

steps.title: Play for points
steps.text: Hosts give points after each game, and everyone follows the scores on the live feed.

ideas.title: Games for your stops
text: A few favourites to get you started.

tips.title: Choose a park with room
tips.text: Open grass, a few trees for shade and space between stops keep teams moving without queues.

tips.title: Bring the gear
tips.text: Ropes, balls, sacks and a Mölkky set: give each host what their game needs.

tips.title: Have a plan B
tips.text: Keep a sheltered spot or an indoor option in mind in case the weather turns.

inNature.imageAlt: Illustration of a small city with a meeting point and seven checkpoints, each with a host and a game: tug-of-war, Mölkky, ball toss, a photo challenge, a sack race, a quiz and a rope jump. Groups leave the meeting point, check in with the host at each checkpoint by scanning a QR code on their phone, and come back.

barCrawl.summary: From bar to bar, a stamp and points at each one.
barCrawl.title: Appro {(Bar crawl)}
text: Take the fun into the city, from one lively bar to the next: karaoke at one, darts or beer pong at another, cocktails and a dance-off to finish.
Every bar has a host at the door and a quick QR check-in. Teams collect a stamp at every stop, earn points along the way and see it all on the live feed.

intro: The classic student Appro: a route through the city's bars, with something fun happening at every stop. Teams collect a stamp at each bar and points along the way.

steps.title: Plan your bars
steps.text: Pick the bars and the order, then add each one as a checkpoint in the app.

steps.title: Put a host at every door
steps.text: Each bar gets a checkpoint host who welcomes teams and runs the activity.

steps.title: Check in and collect stamps
steps.text: Teams show their QR code at the door and collect the bar's stamp.

steps.title: Play for points
steps.text: Karaoke, darts or beer pong: hosts give points, and it all shows up on the live feed.

ideas.title: Ideas for your bars
text: Give every bar its own thing to do.

tips.title: Agree with the bars
tips.text: Let each bar know you're coming, and roughly when, so they're ready for the teams.

tips.title: Keep groups moving
tips.text: Stagger the start times so every bar has a team, but none has a queue.

tips.title: Look after each other
tips.text: Offer drinks without alcohol too, and make sure everyone gets home safely.

barCrawl.imageAlt: Illustration of a city with a meeting point on a square and seven bars, each with a host at the door and something happening on its terrace: karaoke, darts, pool, bingo, a cocktail bar, beer pong and a dance-off. Groups leave the meeting point, check in with the host at each bar by scanning a QR code on their phone, collect a stamp and come back.

cityHopper.summary: Museum, market, food, drinks and games, all in one route.
cityHopper.title: Appro {(City hopper)}
text: Mix it all up. Admire the art at a museum, wander through the market, share a meal at a restaurant, play games in the park and raise a glass at the bar.
Each place has a host and a quick QR check-in. Teams collect stamps at the museum, market, restaurant and bar, win points at the park games, and follow it all on the live feed.

intro: The mixed Appro: a route across the city through all kinds of places. A museum, a market, a restaurant, a bar and a park or two, each with its own host and check-in.

steps.title: Mix your stops
steps.text: Add museums, markets, restaurants, bars and parks as checkpoints, in any order you like.

steps.title: Put a host at each place
steps.text: Every stop gets a checkpoint host who welcomes teams and checks them in.

steps.title: Collect stamps
steps.text: Teams collect a stamp at the museum, market, restaurant and bar.

steps.title: Win points at the games
steps.text: Park games give points, and the live feed keeps everyone up to date.

ideas.title: Places to hop between
text: Mix culture, food, drinks and games.

tips.title: Check opening hours
tips.text: Plan stops around museum and market hours, and book a table at the restaurant.

tips.title: Sort tickets early
tips.text: If a stop needs an entry ticket, include it or let teams know before the day.

tips.title: Keep the walk short
tips.text: Pick places close together so teams spend their time at the stops, not between them.

cityHopper.imageAlt: Illustration of a city with a meeting point on a square and seven places to visit: a market with stalls, a restaurant terrace, a bar, a cocktail bar, a museum with a statue in its courtyard, and two parks with frisbee and tug-of-war. Groups leave the meeting point, check in with a host at each place by scanning a QR code on their phone, collect stamps at the market, restaurant, bars and museum, win points in the parks, and come back.
